partsOfSpeech.translation: based on casual observations or indications rather than rigorous proof; consisting of or relating to anecdotes

examples.en: The evidence is purely anecdotal.
examples.cn: 这证据纯粹是传闻。

examples.en: His report is filled with anecdotal details.
examples.cn: 他的报告充满了轶事细节。

partsOfSpeech.translation: to cut off the head of; to execute by beheading

examples.en: The king was decapitated during the revolution.
examples.cn: 国王在革命中被斩首。

examples.en: The statue's head had been decapitated.
examples.cn: 雕像的头被砍掉了。

partsOfSpeech.translation: the feathers covering a bird's body

examples.en: The peacock's plumage is very colorful.
examples.cn: 孔雀的羽毛色彩斑斓。

examples.en: Birds molt their plumage annually.
examples.cn: 鸟类每年换羽。

partsOfSpeech.translation: a large monkey of the genus Papio, found in Africa and Arabia, with a long doglike snout and large teeth

examples.en: Baboons live in large social groups.
examples.cn: 狒狒生活在大型社会群体中。

partsOfSpeech.translation: to engross; to absorb all the attention or interest of (archaic or obsolete form)
the back part of a four-legged animal, including the hind leg and rump; the rear part of anything

examples.en: The hunter aimed at the deer's hindquarter.
examples.cn: 猎人瞄准了鹿的后腿部位。

partsOfSpeech.translation: a commandment or good deed performed as a religious duty in Judaism; an act of human kindness

examples.en: He performed a mitzvah by helping the elderly woman.
examples.cn: 他帮助了那位老妇人，做了一件善事。

partsOfSpeech.translation: an inflammation of the conjunctiva of the eye, causing redness and discharge; conjunctivitis

examples.en: Pinkeye is highly contagious among children.
examples.cn: 红眼病在儿童中极易传染。

partsOfSpeech.translation: a pilot who flies in a position behind and to the side of a leader in an aircraft formation; a friend who accompanies a person to social events to assist them in romantic pursuits (slang)

translations: （社交中）帮人把妹/牵线的朋友

examples.en: He acted as my wingman at the bar.
examples.cn: 他在酒吧里当我的僚机（帮忙搭讪的朋友）。

partsOfSpeech.translation: a person trained to provide emergency medical care, typically in an ambulance or as part of a rescue team

examples.en: The paramedic rushed to the accident scene.
examples.cn: 急救员赶到了事故现场。

partsOfSpeech.translation: a light two-wheeled vehicle propelled by a motor or by pushing off the ground with one foot; a child's vehicle with two wheels and a steering column

examples.en: Kids love riding scooters in the park.
examples.cn: 孩子们喜欢在公园里骑滑板车。

partsOfSpeech.translation: covered with or resembling grease; oily; slippery; (of a person) unctuous or ingratiating

examples.en: This fried chicken is too greasy.
examples.cn: 这炸鸡太油腻了。

examples.en: His greasy smile made me uncomfortable.
examples.cn: 他谄媚的笑容让我不舒服。

partsOfSpeech.translation: a large metal container for trash, typically used at construction sites or commercial establishments (trademark)

examples.en: They threw the old furniture into the dumpster.
examples.cn: 他们把旧家具扔进了大垃圾箱。

partsOfSpeech.translation: a sequence of five cards of the same suit in card games; one of five children born at the same birth (short for quintuplet); a fifth

examples.en: He was one of identical quints.
examples.cn: 他是同卵五胞胎之一。

partsOfSpeech.translation: Defense Readiness Condition; a scale of alert levels used by the U.S. military

examples.en: The military raised the DEFCON level to 2.
examples.cn: 军方将战备等级提升至二级。

partsOfSpeech.translation: to specify a condition or requirement as part of an agreement; to demand expressly

examples.en: The contract stipulates that payment must be made in 30 days.
examples.cn: 合同规定必须在30天内付款。

examples.en: She stipulated that her name not be used.
examples.cn: 她要求不要使用她的名字。

partsOfSpeech.translation: a long journey by sea, space, or other means
to make a long journey, especially by sea

examples.en: The voyage across the Atlantic took three weeks.
examples.cn: 横渡大西洋的航行花了三周。

examples.en: They voyaged to distant lands.
examples.cn: 他们航行至遥远的土地。

partsOfSpeech.translation: a narrow trench dug in the ground for drainage or irrigation
to dig a ditch; to abandon or get rid of someone or something; to make an emergency landing on water (of aircraft)

examples.en: The car skidded into the ditch.
examples.cn: 汽车滑进了沟里。

examples.en: He ditched his old friends after getting rich.
examples.cn: 他发财后抛弃了老朋友。

partsOfSpeech.translation: a soft, silvery-white metallic chemical element (Ba); used in contrast agents for X-ray imaging

examples.en: Patients drink a barium solution before a stomach X-ray.
examples.cn: 患者在胃部X光前喝下钡溶液。

partsOfSpeech.translation: a procedure in which fluid is injected into the rectum to stimulate bowel movement or administer medication

examples.en: The nurse administered an enema to the constipated patient.
examples.cn: 护士给便秘的病人进行了灌肠。

partsOfSpeech.translation: a complete and ridiculous failure, especially of a planned event or performance

examples.en: The party was a complete fiasco.
examples.cn: 聚会彻底搞砸了。

partsOfSpeech.translation: the action of removing obstacles or unwanted items; official permission, especially to access classified information; the distance between two objects

examples.en: He has security clearance for top-secret files.
examples.cn: 他有查阅绝密文件的安保许可。

examples.en: The bridge has a clearance of 4 meters.
examples.cn: 桥的净空高度为4米。

partsOfSpeech.translation: a person who roams or wanders; a vehicle for exploring the surface of a celestial body; a cricket position

examples.en: The Mars rover sent back new images.
examples.cn: 火星车传回了新图像。

partsOfSpeech.translation: a sharp blow or punch; a type of music or a bar (slang, regional)
to strike sharply
to slap on the buttocks as punishment or for sexual gratification
a slap on the buttocks

examples.en: The mother spanked her child for misbehaving.
examples.cn: 母亲因为孩子不乖而打他屁股。

partsOfSpeech.translation: an arrangement in which a group of people travel together in one car to share costs and reduce traffic
to travel together in a carpool

examples.en: We carpool to work every day.
examples.cn: 我们每天拼车上班。

partsOfSpeech.translation: a figure of speech in which a word or phrase is applied to something not literally applicable, implying similarity

examples.en: "Time is a thief" is a metaphor.
examples.cn: “时间是小偷”是一个隐喻。

partsOfSpeech.translation: waste matter discharged from the bowels; feces

examples.en: The sidewalk was covered in dog excrement.
examples.cn: 人行道上满是狗粪。

partsOfSpeech.translation: a ship or large boat; a hollow container, especially for liquids; a tube or duct in the body (e.g., blood vessel)

examples.en: A cargo vessel arrived at the port.
examples.cn: 一艘货船抵达港口。

examples.en: He drank water from a clay vessel.
examples.cn: 他用陶器容器喝水。

partsOfSpeech.translation: close observation of a person or place, especially for monitoring criminal activity or gathering intelligence

examples.en: The bank is under police surveillance.
examples.cn: 该银行处于警方监视之下。

partsOfSpeech.translation: in a manner that is so delicate or precise as to be difficult to analyze or describe; not obviously or overtly

examples.en: She subtly hinted that she wanted to leave.
examples.cn: 她微妙地暗示想离开。

partsOfSpeech.translation: to move or go in a furtive or stealthy manner; to take something secretly
a sneaky person; a furtive act
acting in a furtive or stealthy way

examples.en: He tried to sneak out of the room.
examples.cn: 他试图偷偷溜出房间。

partsOfSpeech.translation: in a way that causes someone to believe something; persuasively

examples.en: She argued convincingly for the proposal.
examples.cn: 她有说服力地为该提议辩护。

partsOfSpeech.translation: impudence; bold and disrespectful behavior; bitterness or resentment; a bile secretion; a skin sore
to irritate or annoy someone greatly; to make sore by rubbing

examples.en: He had the gall to blame me for his mistake.
examples.cn: 他竟有脸把他的错误归咎于我。

partsOfSpeech.translation: meat cut from the breast or lower chest of a cow or other animal

examples.en: Smoked brisket is a Texas specialty.
examples.cn: 熏牛胸肉是德克萨斯州的特产。

partsOfSpeech.translation: showing too much curiosity about other people's affairs; prying

examples.en: Our neighbor is very nosy.
examples.cn: 我们的邻居很好管闲事。

partsOfSpeech.translation: the grounds or playground of a school

examples.en: Children were playing in the schoolyard.
examples.cn: 孩子们在学校操场上玩耍。

partsOfSpeech.translation: dead; no longer living
a dead person, especially one who has died recently

examples.en: The deceased left no will.
examples.cn: 死者没有留下遗嘱。

partsOfSpeech.translation: to pretend to be affected by a feeling, state, or injury; to simulate

examples.en: She feigned illness to avoid the exam.
examples.cn: 她装病逃避考试。

partsOfSpeech.translation: a gentle wind; something that is easy to do
to move quickly and lightly; to progress effortlessly

examples.en: A cool breeze blew through the window.
examples.cn: 一阵凉风吹进窗户。

examples.en: He breezed through the test.
examples.cn: 他轻松通过了考试。

partsOfSpeech.translation: a viscous substance alleged to emanate from the body of a spiritualist medium; the outer layer of the cytoplasm of a cell
to separate or free from a physical body or concrete form

examples.en: The voice seemed disembodied, coming from nowhere.
examples.cn: 那声音似乎无形无体，不知从何而来。

partsOfSpeech.translation: an extraordinary and welcome event that is not explicable by natural or scientific laws; a remarkable achievement

examples.en: It was a miracle that no one died in the crash.
examples.cn: 车祸中无人死亡真是个奇迹。

partsOfSpeech.translation: a narrow crack or fissure in rock or a wall

examples.en: Plants grew from every crevice in the cliff.
examples.cn: 植物的从悬崖的每个裂缝中长出。

partsOfSpeech.translation: astonishing or overwhelming; so great as to cause one to stagger
present participle of stagger: to walk unsteadily

examples.en: The cost of the project was staggering.
examples.cn: 项目的成本高得惊人。

partsOfSpeech.translation: to walk unsteadily as if about to fall; to cause to doubt or hesitate; to arrange in overlapping or alternating positions
an unsteady walk or movement

examples.en: He staggered to his feet after the blow.
examples.cn: 挨了一击后，他踉跄着站起来。

examples.en: We staggered the work shifts to avoid crowding.
examples.cn: 我们错开工作班次以避免拥挤。
